name: Sourced claim: two sources, one chip
when: A claim that two outlets back: a big left-aligned claim (x 120), then one source box naming both. It stands on the shot blurred and dimmed (`ground`).
anchor: The scene starts on the claim's first word; the source box (`source_at`) lands once the claim has landed, or as the voice names the outlets.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.line1: the claim's first line, as the voice says it
vars.line2: the claim's second line; empty = a one-line claim
vars.source: the words before the outlets: Confirmed by, Reported by
vars.outlet1: the first outlet's name. Shown as text when it has no logo, else its logo's alt text
vars.logo1: the first outlet's logo file: build_video.mjs fills it from the repo's assets/logos/ when the outlet is listed in logos.json (or give a file the user supplied); empty = its name as text
vars.logo1_h: the first logo's height in px: about 38 for a wordmark (Edge 37.7, The New York Times 36.8), 30 for a very long one, 44 for IGN, 61 for a square mark (Rockstar)
vars.logo1_trim: px taken off the space after the first logo: 14 for a square mark such as Rockstar's, else 0
vars.outlet2: the second outlet's name, after the ampersand. Shown as text when it has no logo, else its logo's alt text
vars.logo2: the second outlet's logo file: build_video.mjs fills it from the repo's assets/logos/ when the outlet is listed in logos.json (or give a file the user supplied); empty = its name as text
vars.logo2_h: the second logo's height in px, as logo1_h
vars.logo2_trim: px taken off the box's right padding after the second logo: 14 for a square mark, else 0
vars.source_at: seconds after the start: when the source box lands
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The claim's lines, the source words, both outlets and the box's landing time are values; each logo is a file from the project (empty = that outlet's name as text), and the lab's per-outlet logo sizes are the values logo1_h, logo1_trim, logo2_h and logo2_trim. The blurred, dimmed shot is the `ground` (the validated clip's exact filter), baked by the project.
